print_css_guidance.print_styles: @media print { body { background: #fff; font-size: 11pt; } .no-print { display: none !important; } .print-only { display: block !important; } .page-break { page-break-before: always; } table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; } th, td { border: 1px solid #000; padding: 4px 8px; text-align: left; } th { background-color: #f2f2f2 !important; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; } .text-right { text-align: right; } }

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always set explicit data-testid attributes on key interactive components, form inputs, buttons, status indicators, and summary numbers.
Ensure input components handling money have right alignment and auto-formatting with dot separators (e.g. 10.000.000).
Keep header backgrounds non-transparent with proper backdrop blurs or solid fills.
Ensure print preview views closely match standard Indonesian official document standards with formal kop surat letterheads.
